body:
Hi Nathan,

I wanted to add a bit more context on why I reached out. Since May, part of my co-op has involved working directly with teams at Anthropic and NVIDIA to deploy their biological research workflows onto robotic lab hardware. My work is on the general planning and search layer underneath that, figuring out how to execute new workflows without deadlocks, resource conflicts or other edge cases that could crash a run, then using digital twins to simulate them before they touch the hardware.

Being this close to frontier AI and biological research has also made me think a lot about who these advances will actually benefit. A lot of the push around longevity and medicine seems likely to reach the ultra wealthy first. I'm only one introduction away from Anthropic's CEO and have been able to ask some of these questions pretty close to that world, while at the same time countries like Sierra Leone are still losing people to diseases like tuberculosis that we already know how to treat.

Partly for my own morality, I want to offset some of that by putting more of my time into work with a clear benefit to society. That's a big part of why Aclima stood out to me, and the planning side seemed close enough to what I already do that I thought I could actually help.

If there's a technical problem on your side that could fit into a 4–6 week paid contract, I'd be very interested in taking ownership of it. The routing question was one thought, but I'd much rather work on something the team already needs solved. I work pretty intensely and am used to getting to something concrete quickly.

Happy to hop on a call if anything comes to mind.

Best,
Andrew
